gauntlet: question
The repaired acme/widgets#77 now has one criterion, "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." I am treating that row as `in-scope`. It matches the path already traced from `settings/resolver.ts:12` into `ui/report-view.ts:30`, so it needs no further cut question. The framing stays kept.

One behavior is still undecided: what the new setting controls when the user switches workspaces. Today, filters stay active after a switch and can hide rows in the new workspace. Which outcome should ship?
A) A setting `resetFiltersOnWorkspaceChange`, default on - switching workspaces clears all report filters unless the user turns it off.
B) The same setting, default off - today's carry-over stays the default, and users opt in to clearing.
C) A setting with a "prune" mode - on a switch, only filters that reference values missing from the new workspace are dropped, and valid filters carry over.
D) other - name it.
Recommendation: A - the reported harm is rows hidden by stale filters, and a default-on reset fixes that for every user while still letting anyone who wants carry-over keep it.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
gauntlet: question
The saved repair to acme/widgets#77 now requires the shared settings resolver, matching the verified resolver-to-report-view path. I’ll retain that ownership decision. What behavior should the new setting select when switching workspaces?
A) Reset report filters so filters from the previous workspace cannot hide rows.
B) Preserve report filters across workspace changes.
C) Restore each workspace’s own last-used filters.
D) other - name it.
Recommendation: A - it directly addresses the reported hidden-row problem without introducing per-workspace filter storage.
